description: The state government has signed an MoU with AstraZeneca Pharma to deploy AI based lung cancer screening tech that will screen a patient for 29 lung diseases in one chest X-ray.
body_lead: In a latest technology deployment in the health-tech sector, the Karnataka government has entered into a partnership with global pharma major AstraZeneca Pharma, to deploy Artificial Intelligence (AI) based lung cancer screening technology in the state. According to the memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the pharma giant, AI based cancer screening technology will screen a patient for 29 lung diseases in one chest X-ray.
